name: BACH_0293
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (72%)** · Ambiguous: Normal vs InSitu · Careful review
Tier 3 flag: 90% conformal set includes InSitu (15%) and Benign (11%), with 2% invasive risk [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 72%, InSitu 15%, Benign 11%, Invasive 2% (ECE 5%, n=132) | Favors Normal; low invasive risk |
| Conformal set | Normal, Benign, InSitu at 90% target (90% coverage, CI 76%–98%) | Cannot exclude InSitu or Benign |
| Reliability / OOD | Reliability 93%, OOD 88th percentile, 12/12 regions [F6] (AUROC 0.70) | Input passed; high OOD |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal (83%–87%) [F5]; Benign contrast 83% (BACH_0369) | Neighbors Normal; Benign close |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 3, 7, 11) · ↓ invasive · Top score (-0.76) [F2], 0/20 AI spot check · Unreliable
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 0, 1, 4) · ↓ invasive · Score -0.69 [F3]; caption check inconsistent, 18/20 AI spot check · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 7, 8, 11) · ↓ invasive · Score -0.47 [F4]; 20/20 AI spot check · Validated
- **HoVer-Net nuclei counts** (regions 2, 7, 11) · context · Insufficient tumor nuclei flag, yet 10 neoplastic in region 2 · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; deleting top 3 risk regions drops invasive score above random (+0.0114, CI 0.0021–0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion CI -0.0088–0.0064 includes 0); `normal_lobules` (-0.76) and `mitoses` (-0.31) are Unreliable (0/20 AI spot checks).

## Could be wrong if
- InSitu (15%) or Benign (11%) is missed; drafted orders suggest deeper levels and CK5/6, ER.
- High OOD (88th percentile) or similarity to Benign case BACH_0369 (83%) masks focal atypia.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 3, 7, 11**: Highest risk (0.002–0.004); verify claimed normal lobules and benign stroma.
2. **Regions 2, 6, 8**: Check 10 called neoplastic nuclei (2), duct atypia (6), and invasion score (8).
3. **Regions 0, 1, 4**: Inspect tubules for in situ changes before ordering deeper levels or CK5/6, ER.
